idea: Producer (MMA) and consumer (FP32) warps in the A100 forward, tiles through mbarriers
reason: closed by the proposal's own rule (more than 10 % of serial): each side keeps only part of the 12 warps for its own latency, which costs what the overlap gains.
notes: No ledger anchor. Filled from the plan section Producer/consumer warps (third set, idea 1): two A100-SXM4 containers (bc0a84ae, 975e560f); run 1 win came with a slower serial base; no spills.

idea: Register caps for the A100 w' kernel
numbers: A100 lab cap 72 1.201, cap 64 1.477 (spills); uncapped stays
baseline: uncapped (base 3.14 ms at 96 registers, no spills)
reason: register caps add local memory (cap 72 1.201 with 88 B local, cap 64 1.477 with 128 B local), so the A100 stays uncapped.
notes: No ledger anchor. Filled from the plan's A100-SXM4 w' lab and REDUX A/B section (thermalised capture 6c2f2967); the numbers match the index row.

reason: splitting the channels does not shrink the per-edge register state; it multiplies the per-edge preamble and adds a cross-warp reduction.
notes: No ledger anchor. Plan item 1 of the external review's six ideas gives the reason and calls the split a lab bound (F-split2 / F-split4, partials added with atomics). The split numbers are not in the plan; they come from the index row.

idea: 3xTF32 projection with separate accumulators for the small products, or the MMA asm without volatile
notes: No ledger anchor. Plan section A100 stage bounds (capture 6c2f2967) lists tc-mma-free 0.999 (bitwise), tc-2acc 1.306 (144 B spills), tc-3acc 1.504 (280 B); it gives no stated rejection reason and no baseline.

idea: 3xTF32 projection as TF32 big*big plus FP16 m16n8k16 small products (2^11 shift)
numbers: A100-SXM4 1.017 (base 3.60 ms; 167 registers and 40 B local, hybrid 168 and 48 B); RTX 5060 Ti 0.851 (255 registers, 8 B local); accuracy 7e-7 to 1.7e-6
baseline: the 3xTF32 product (base 3.60 ms on the A100)
reason: the per-fragment FP16 packs (12 cvt per (g, m, 16 k)) and the register limit eat the third of the MMA time it saves.
notes: No ledger anchor. Filled from the plan's TF32 plus FP16 hybrid projection paragraph (kernel lab 3e4f9310; A100 run results/round5-20261105/runs/a100-hybrid16-rebuild-cost/). Rejected on the A100 only; the 5060 Ti ratio 0.851 is faster.
